title: Conway's Game of Life
briefDesc: A more customized version of the famous life simulator Conway's Game of Life. My version exists on a restricted grid while allowing cell-growth settings to be changed, creating new interesting patterns as an extension of the original game.

title: covey.town
briefDesc: Currently working on adding and updating UI features for an open source repository as part of a course curriclum. My main goals are making quality of life changes to poorly designed UI, and updating a large amount of legacy code that is present.

title: Study Planner
briefDesc: An in progress personal planner that aims to make an efficient study planner for college students. Project currently uses HTML, CSS, and Python with future implementation requiring JavaScript and SQL.

title: Simple Perl-Like Compiler
briefDesc: Designed as part of a course project, I developed a lexical analyzer, parser, and interpreter for a simplified version of the Perl programming language. AST generation to mimic and interpret 18 EBNF rules.

title: Code-Generation in LLMs
briefDesc: A project developed as part of a paid research experience to improve large language models for code generation. My study focused on leveraging the systematic formatting of ASTs for Python code to efficiently generate code with less tokens.
